description: Coerce: quantizes every channel of one polyphonic cable to the nearest of the voltages arriving on another

inputs.text: The voltages to quantize to; anything can be sent here, including voltages that move while they are being used

outputs.text: The quantized voltages, one channel for each channel of the input, in the same order

notes: with nothing patched into the quantize input there is nothing to quantize to, and the input passes through unchanged
quantizing happens every sample, so this works at audio rate and the quantizing voltages may move while they are in use
menu: Octave Fold — treats the quantizing voltages as repeating in every octave, so only the note matters
Restrict — quantizes to the given voltages themselves, octave and all
Up — rounds each input to the next quantizing voltage above it
Closest — rounds each input to the nearest quantizing voltage
Down — rounds each input down to the previous quantizing voltage

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads no channels.
